reason: I do not know this website and I would have to hand it my resume and my data. Even if the free check is useful, I do not pay for things I have not seen work, and my family's money is not for trying out a new site.
objection: Who is behind this site, and what happens to my resume after I upload it? Nothing I read says who runs it.
would_change_my_mind: A friend from my college who got a real placement using it, or a clear free result I can see before I give any card or pay anything.
